The main result is that there is some constant `c > 0` such that, if `A ⊆ {1, ..., N}` contains no
non-trivial arithmetic progression of length 3, then `|A| ≤ N/exp(c * (log n)^(1/12)))` for some
constant `c > 0`.
scope: README The source paragraph only (1/12 exponent); the later Content section separately advertises a 1/9 improvement. A is a finite subset of natural numbers without nontrivial length-three arithmetic progressions. README uses {1,...,N}; Lean uses range N; endpoint convention requires human review. No final label.
